summary: Frontend-only verification of (a) DashboardInsights chart polish — Monthly Spend (280px tall bars) and Anomalies Over Time (240px tall stacked bars) on caregiver dashboard, and (b) Log a Scenario stepper UX: cancel-confirm modal + Switch Workflow drawer. Logged in as cathy@example.com (family plan, seeded statements). All 7 review_request bullet points verified positively. Regression smoke (Switch Provider, Calendar Month/Week/Agenda, AT&HM Title Case status, Settings without SMS tab) all pass — no regressions found.

verified_features.evidence: data-testid='burn-rate-chart' present. 6 burn-bar-N children. Container 280px. Inner bar heights up to 253px (max bar at 7.5k). Y-axis ticks $0/$2k/$4k/$6k/$8k visible. Gridlines rendered. Legend: 'Gross billed' (solid) + 'Co-payment' (dashed) shapes. Last-month-gross $269 visible. Tooltip text confirms hover behaviour.

verified_features.feature: Anomalies Over Time chart — tall stacked bars
verified_features.evidence: data-testid='anomaly-timeline' present. 8 anomaly-bar-N children. Container 240px. Integer y-ticks 0/4/8/12/16 visible. Legend with AlertCircle/AlertTriangle/Info icons + colour swatches (Alert / Warning / Info). Totals chip shows 11 alerts / 18 warnings / 21 info. Stacked terracotta/gold/sage segments render.

verified_features.feature: No console errors on chart render
verified_features.evidence: No error/warning console messages captured during dashboard load.

Code path verified in /app/frontend/src/components/DashboardInsights.jsx: EmptyChartState component renders when statements.length===0 with placeholder faint bars + Inbox icon + explanatory copy at 280px (burn) and 240px (anomaly). Could not live-test with seeded cathy account (has 8 statements). Implementation appears correct; main agent may want to spot-test with a brand new caregiver account if needed.

Started 'reassessment' workflow, selected 'Phone' on first field, clicked Close → modal opened with data-testid='workflow-cancel-modal'. All three buttons present: workflow-cancel-keep, workflow-cancel-save-exit, workflow-cancel-discard. 'Keep Working' correctly dismisses modal and preserves state.

Inside active reassessment workflow, header chip data-testid='workflow-switcher-open' visible. Click opens drawer (workflow-switcher-drawer) sliding from the right. Lists OTHER workflows only — 'workflow-switch-to-hospitalisation', 'workflow-switch-to-death' (reassessment excluded). Close X (workflow-switcher-close) present. Clicking 'Manage a hospital stay' switches to workflow-active-hospitalisation and closes the drawer.
/app/provider-switch loads. Heading 'Switch Provider' visible. 7 step/wizard-tagged elements detected. No errors.
react-big-calendar renders with toggles ['Month','Week','Agenda'] all present (Day not used).
Intro copy mentioning assistive/home-mod present. Status select first two options 'Assistive Tech', 'Home Mod' in Title Case as expected.
Settings tabs: Profile / Plan and Billing / Family Members / Weekly Digest / Notifications / Appearance / Usage / Security / Danger Zone. No 'SMS' tab present.

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardInsights.jsx (~457 lines) — well-structured, accessible (aria-labels, shape-based legend, AAA-friendly contrast classes). No issues.

WorkflowsPanel.jsx (~411 lines) — cancel-confirm modal correctly triggers only when payload/completedSteps/stepIdx indicate progress. 'Save and Exit' and 'Discard and Start Over' currently call the same doClose() — both just clear local state. If the design intent is for 'Save and Exit' to persist a draft to backend/localStorage while 'Discard' wipes it, this is NOT yet implemented (the UI copy says 'will be saved as a draft on this device' but no actual persistence layer is wired in this component). Main agent should confirm whether draft persistence is expected for UI-1 §7 — if so, both buttons currently behave identically.

Minor: shortPeriod() in DashboardInsights produces duplicate x-axis labels (e.g. 'May' x3, 'Apr' x2 in current seeded data) because it only outputs the month name. Consider adding day/year suffix when adjacent labels collide. Cosmetic only.
